options.description: Ibusuki's beachfront hot-sand burial; the signature southern Kyushu onsen.

options.name: Senjokaku Pavilion
options.description: Unfinished 1587 hall beside the five-storied pagoda overlooking the Seto Inland Sea.

options.name: Seto Inland Sea Private Art Cruise
options.description: Private catamaran past Naoshima, Inujima and Teshima; 3- or 8-hour charters.

options.name: Seven Hells of Beppu
options.description: Seven look-don't-touch geothermal pools; one ticket covers all, two need a short drive.

options.name: Shakotan Cape Kamui
options.description: Cliff walk out to a cape over water the locals call Shakotan Blue, plus the best uni in Hokkaido - though the uni season really starts in June. Public transport is thin; car or seasonal bus tour.

options.name: Shikisai-no-oka
options.description: Fifteen hectares of striped flower hills - but the stripes only start in late June. Late May is tulips and fresh green, free entry, and almost nobody there.

options.name: Shikoku Pilgrimage Temple Walk
options.description: Walk a short chain of the 88-temple route near Tokushima to feel how the pilgrimage works.

options.name: Shinsekai
options.description: Retro kushikatsu district beneath Tsutenkaku Tower.

image.artist: Dick Thomas Johnson from Tokyo, Japan

options.name: Shiraito Falls Aso
options.description: Peaceful white-thread falls in the Aso hills.
packages: 07 Kyushu/Mt Aso :: Mt Aso / Kusasenri grasslands

options.name: Shirakawa-go
options.description: UNESCO gassho-zukuri thatched village between Kanazawa and Takayama; reserve bus seats.

options.name: Shirakawa-go Gassho no Sato
options.description: Quieter open-air annex of relocated farmhouses across the river from the main village.

options.name: Shirakawa-go and Kanazawa Day Tour
options.description: Bus tour from Kanazawa Station with Shirakawa-go free time plus optional Kenrokuen and Higashi Chaya.

options.name: Shirogane Blue Pond
options.description: Aluminium hydroxide turns the water an unreal blue against dead birch trunks. Colour is strongest May through August, and May has none of the July bus crowds.

options.name: Shiroyama Observation Deck
options.description: The classic city view across the bay to Sakurajima.

options.name: Shodoshima Soy Sauce Brewery Tour and Tasting
options.description: From $184pp · 180 min private for 1–7 · English soy-sauce sommelier · two Hishio-no-Sato breweries plus a tasting lunch · free cancellation to 11 days out · no natto for 3 days before.

options.name: Shojin Ryori Meal
options.description: Traditional Buddhist vegan cuisine balanced across flavors, colors and methods.

options.name: Shokin Soy Sauce
options.description: Second stop in Hishio-no-Sato: iconic cedar-barrel brewery with over a year of fermentation.

options.name: Shukkei-en Garden
options.description: 400-year daimyo stroll garden with a bomb-victim memorial; strong in any season.

image.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Fg2 assumed (based on copyright claims).

options.name: Suganuma
options.description: Tiny thatched hamlet usually paired with Ainokura.

options.name: Sumire Miso Ramen
options.description: The reference bowl for Sapporo miso: garlic, ginger, a lard cap that keeps it scalding. Cash only.

options.name: Sun Messe Nichinan
options.description: Officially authorised moai replicas on a coastal hill; ¥1,000, skippable unless passing.

options.name: Susukino
options.description: Northern Japan's biggest nightlife district - ramen alley, soup curry, izakaya, bars running past 02:00.

options.name: TOTO Museum
options.description: Free and genuinely good museum of Japanese toilet design.

options.name: Takachiho Day Tour from Fukuoka
options.description: Guided day trip when driving to Takachiho isn't practical.

options.name: Takachiho Gorge
options.description: Basalt-columned gorge with Manai Falls; free entry, ¥500 parking, jammed at weekends.

options.name: Takachiho Gorge Boat Rental
options.description: The iconic 30-minute rowboat under the falls; book a timed slot, best light 10:00–12:00.

options.name: Takayama Festival Floats Exhibition Hall
options.description: Ornate floats from Takayama's spring and autumn matsuri, displayed year-round.

options.name: Tanaka Sake Brewery Kikkogura
options.description: Working brewery near the distillery with free tasting of roughly ten sakes and liqueurs; the usual pairing with Yoichi.

options.name: Tanukikoji Shopping Street
options.description: Covered arcade running seven blocks; the rain plan and a shortcut between Odori and Susukino.

options.name: Tatsumaki Jigoku
options.description: Geyser hell erupting roughly every 30 minutes.

options.name: Teramachi - Kofukuji Area
options.description: Quieter temple streets away from the best-known harbor sights.

options.name: Teshima
options.description: Art island with the Teshima Art Museum and shoreline installations.
packages: 08 Shikoku/Naoshima :: Naoshima + Art House Project deep pass

options.name: Tochoji Temple
options.description: Five-story pagoda and a large seated wooden Buddha in central Fukuoka.

options.name: Todai-ji
options.description: Great Eastern Temple housing the world's largest bronze Buddha; ticket to enter the hall.
packages: 03 Kyoto/Nara :: Nara park guided walking tour

options.name: Tokyo Mt Fuji Day Tour
options.description: Bus day trip linking six Fuji Five Lakes viewpoints; weekends may reorder stops.

options.name: Tsujun Bridge
options.description: Japan's largest stone aqueduct with scheduled water releases; free parking.

options.name: Tsutenkaku Tower
options.description: Eiffel-inspired Osaka tower and Shinsekai landmark.

options.name: USJ Super Nintendo World
options.description: Trip Must-Do · area entry needs the official USJ app Timed Entry or Advance Booking · 5th-anniversary run Mar 2026–Jan 2027 · park ticket separate.

options.name: Uchiko Historic Town
options.description: Wax-merchant town of pale plaster storefronts and wooden machiya.
packages: 08 Shikoku/Ozu Uchiko :: Ozu + Uchiko historic towns day

options.name: Uchiko-za
options.description: Early-1900s kabuki theatre still hosting performances; you can walk the stage machinery.
packages: 08 Shikoku/Ozu Uchiko :: Ozu + Uchiko historic towns day

options.name: Udo Jingu
options.description: Vermilion shrine inside a seaside cave with the lucky-stone toss; free entry.

options.name: Ukiha Inari Shrine
options.description: Nearly 100 torii climbing a hillside over the valley; drive up to skip the climb.

options.name: Umeda
options.description: North Osaka's skyscraper district; the modern counterweight to Kyoto.

options.name: Umi Jigoku
options.description: The cobalt-blue hell, the best of the seven.

options.name: Unoko Falls
options.description: Valley waterfall near Gokase for outdoor-leaning days.

options.name: Uzunomichi Walkway
options.description: Glass-floored walkway under the Onaruto Bridge looking straight down at the current.

options.name: Wazuka Obubu Tea Farm Tour
options.description: English-speaking tea farmers · field and factory tour, tasting and harvest events · bus from Kamo Station to Higashi-Wazuka then 5 min walk · call ahead for schedule.

options.name: Wisteria Tunnel of Nakayama
options.description: Spring wisteria walkway; peak is typically late April, so late May is past it.

options.name: Yamawaki Hamono Knife Maker
options.description: 100-year-old Sakai knife house; sharpening lesson and optional custom order — Tuesday and Thursday only.

options.name: Yanagawa Canal Cruise
options.description: Poled flat-bottomed punt through the old castle-town canals.

options.name: Yanagibashi Rengo Market
options.description: Compact local market known as Fukuoka's kitchen.

options.name: Yasaka Shrine Kokura
options.description: Shrine inside the Kokura castle grounds.

options.name: Yasui Gorge
options.description: Trails through moss, waterfalls and the translucent pools of "Niyodo Blue".
packages: 08 Shikoku/Niyodo :: Yasui Gorge / Niyodo Blue day

options.name: Yoichi and Otaru Guided Day Tour
options.description: Small-group English-guided day on local trains and buses: Yoichi distillery, Tanaka sake brewery, Sakaimachi Street, canal cruise. Around 26,000 yen per person - the culinary deep dive for Track C.

options.name: Yono Falls
options.description: Big cascade up a narrow steep road plus a short uphill walk.

options.name: Yoshikien Garden
options.description: Lovely Nara garden, free for foreign visitors, right beside Isuien.

options.name: Yuasa Soy Sauce Brewery
options.description: Free ~20-minute tour where Japanese soy sauce was born; 09:00–16:00, shop on site.

options.name: Yufuin Floral Village
options.description: Cotswolds-pastiche shopping village; kitsch and crowded — go before 11:00 or skip.

options.name: Yufuin Onsen
options.description: Popular hot-spring town and shopping street; tour buses swamp it after 11:00.

options.name: Yukemuri Observation Deck
options.description: Overlook of steam plumes rising across the whole Beppu hillside.

options.name: Yumotozaka Shopping Street
options.description: Edo-style Arima street of cafes and shops, occasional geiko shamisen practice.

options.name: Yunohira Observation Deck
options.description: Highest accessible viewpoint on Sakurajima, over lava fields and the bay.

options.name: Zen Meditation at Gokurakuji
options.description: Bookable zazen with the head monk; a standout cultural experience.

options.name: teamLab Forest Fukuoka
options.description: Immersive digital art beside the baseball stadium.
